_README: Per-company plausible price range, taken from an accredited external
source. A close outside a company's range is corrupt by definition, which
makes it independent evidence rather than an inference from neighbouring
This matters where the surrounding window cannot settle the question on its
own. SMER spends 355 days at ~3.00 and 200 days at ~0.30 across 2019-2021,
so a four-month median is sometimes drawn from the corrupt level and the
window-majority check has to decline those rows. A floor resolves them: any
SMER close under KES 1.00 is wrong regardless of what its neighbours say.
The floor establishes THAT a row is corrupt. The surrounding window still
chooses the factor, because 0.15 could be a x10 or a x100 error and only
Add a company only after checking a real source, and record which one.
Companies absent from this file fall back to the window rules alone.

SMER.name: Sameer Africa Plc
note: The chart's y-axis bottoms at 1.5 and the series never approaches it;
the quoted range across 2003-2026 runs from roughly 2.00 to 40.00, with
the current price at 19.30. Sameer has never traded below KES 1.00.
243 rows in RTDB sit under this floor, concentrated in 2018-2021, and
every one of them is a misplaced decimal point.
